primary_screen: AC63 <= 6 AND dHash64 <= 6; sensitivity thresholds 0,2,4,6,8 are candidate counts only
hash_definition: EXIF-transposed grayscale; LANCZOS resize. AC63 uses 32x32 orthonormal DCT, first 8x8 coefficients minus DC, thresholded at their median (63 bits). dHash64 compares horizontal neighbors after 9x8 resize.
exclusions: Exact-byte variants are collapsed to one node; all rows remain attached. Only first frame of animated images is screened. Missing/ambiguous/decode errors are explicit and prevent a completeness claim.
scope: Explicit crosslayer CV manifest, not the historical fixed-slice Twitter runs in Table 1
verdict: CANDIDATE SCREEN ONLY; manual review required; no event/semantic independence or score correction established
